formats.<name>.anf: one GF(2) polynomial per line in the shared variable naming
formats.<name>.cnf: the same system with every parity row Tseitin-expanded to clauses
formats.<name>.dimacs: DIMACS CNF with native parity rows as `x` lines (CryptoMiniSat / WDSat convention)
formats.<name>.magma: the system as a Magma script computing its Groebner basis
formats.INFO<name>: curve, modulus, target abscissa, certified label, planted witness and its SAT assignment, encoding sizes
